name: Anal cancer
theme: the surgery-sparing original · the HPV receipt

meta.title: Anal cancer in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Squamous cell carcinoma of the anal canal and margin, adult
meta.population: Adults with anal squamous cell carcinoma - THE SURGERY-SPARING ORIGINAL: Nigro's 1974 preliminary report (PMID-verified - with its own exact-title trap: a 1993 verbatim-titled reprint decoy) proved chemoradiation could cure without removing the organ, demoting abdominoperineal resection to salvage DECADES before organ preservation was fashionable - and the property suite enforces the legacy (no APR on any frontline card). THE HPV RECEIPT: roughly 90% HPV-attributable (the attribution fraction memory-grade, marked; HPV16-in-tumor 81% and the p16/HPV survival receipts verified - OS HR 0.27), incidence and mortality RISING (Deshmukh verified: mortality +3.1%/yr), the burden concentrated in people living with HIV (modeled as an input) - and prevention now has a randomized receipt: ANCHOR (DOI-cited - its primary PMID hid behind a commentary-decoy cluster) showed treating HSIL cuts anal-cancer incidence 57% in PLWH.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the surgery-sparing original. THE DEFINITIVE-CRT SPINE is fully PMID-verified end-to-end - the registry's cleanest trial ladder: Nigro 1974 -> ACT I (585 randomized; the 13-year update's verified per-100 arithmetic: 25.3 fewer locoregional relapses, 12.5 fewer anal-cancer deaths) + EORTC 22861 (CRT beats RT) -> RTOG 87-04 (mitomycin earns its place; salvage baked into the design) -> RTOG 98-11 with its PUBLICATION-CONFLATION DISCIPLINE (the 2008 primary did NOT show the DFS difference - the significant mitomycin DFS/OS advantage belongs to the 2012 UPD…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: TNM by size (T1 <=2cm / T2 2-5 / T3 >5 / T4 invasion; N includes inguinal nodes) - secondhand per NCCN, operationalized as the stage router (early T1-2N0 / locally advanced / metastatic); PET-CT staging conventions secondhand
meta.response: Clinical complete response assessed with THE 26-WEEK PATIENCE (the ACT II post-hoc paper verified; the terminology corrected this run - it is DELAYED RESPONSE ASSESSMENT before declaring failure, not rectal-style watch-and-wait; the conversion statistic memory-grade); metastatic disease on PFS/OS at POD1UM-303's verified grade (progression/death risk reduced 37%)

refs.label: NIGRO 1974 - the surgery-sparing original: 'Combined therapy for cancer of the anal canal: a preliminary report' (Dis Colon Rectum 1974;17:354-6 - PMID 4830803, pubmed-url-match). THE REPRINT DECOY documented (the registry's second exact-title collision): PMID 8348857 is the 1993 classic-article REPRINT with the verbatim title plus a trailing year - a naive title-matcher grabs it. The 1985 follow-on matched (3918441) | PMID 4830803 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

ACT I: UKCCCR randomized RT vs CRT (Lancet 1996 - PMID 8874455, pubmed-url-match: 585 randomized, 290/295 - verified) + THE 13-YEAR ARITHMETIC (Br J Cancer 2010 - PMID 20354531, matched): per 100 CRT patients at 12 years - 25.3 fewer locoregional relapses, 12.5 fewer anal-cancer deaths (verified snippet). Surgery reserved for failures - the doctrine in the design | PMID 8874455 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

EORTC 22861 (Bartelink, JCO 1997 - PMID 9164216, pubmed-url-match): concomitant CRT superior to RT alone - 3-yr local control 68%, colostomy-free 72% (verified snippet, secondary grade) | PMID 9164216 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

RTOG 87-04/ECOG (Flam, JCO 1996 - PMID 8823332, pubmed-url-match): 310 randomized - MITOMYCIN earns its place, and SALVAGE CRT-then-APR for residual disease is baked into the design (verified snippet) - the salvage doctrine's home; pooled treatment-time analysis matched (20956625) | PMID 8823332 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

RTOG 98-11 with THE PUBLICATION DISCIPLINE (nuance correction this run): the 2008 JAMA primary (PMID 18430910, pubmed-url-match) did NOT show a significant DFS difference - its notable finding was higher cumulative colostomy with cisplatin; the SIGNIFICANT mitomycin DFS/OS advantage belongs to the 2012 LONG-TERM UPDATE (PMID 23150707, matched; the specific 67.8/57.8 and 78.3/70.7 values memory-grade, held). The spec cites the update for the DFS claim - conflating the two papers is the documented trap | PMID 23150707 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

ACT II (James, Lancet Oncol 2013 - PMID 23578724, pubmed-url-match): 2x2 factorial - MAINTENANCE NULL (3-yr PFS 74% vs 73%, HR 0.95, p=0.70 - verified snippet); the standard's own doses verified (mitomycin 12 d1; cisplatin-arm 60 d1,29; 5-FU 1000 d1-4/29-32; 50.4 Gy/28); the trial's own conclusion: 5-FU/mitomycin/50.4 Gy 'should remain standard practice' (the 'equivalent-ish' briefing wording sharpened - the cCR percentages memory-grade); colostomy analysis matched (24827136) | PMID 23578724 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

ACCORD 03 final analysis (Peiffert, JCO 2012 - PMID 22529257, pubmed-url-match): 306 patients, 2x2 - NO colostomy-free-survival advantage for induction chemotherapy OR high-dose boost (>59 Gy) - both nulls verified snippet; the escalation-by-habit guard | PMID 22529257 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

RTOG 0529 QUALIFIED (nuance correction this run): dose-painted IMRT phase 2 (Kachnic, IJROBP 2013 - PMID 23154075, pubmed-url-match) - its PRIMARY endpoint (>=15% reduction in combined grade >=2 GI/GU acute toxicity vs the 98-11 benchmark) was NOT met; the significant reductions were grade >=3 dermatologic and GI toxicity (memory-grade detail). 'IMRT reduced toxicity' unqualified is the documented trap - IMRT is standard practice with an honestly mixed receipt | PMID 23154075 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE 26-WEEK PATIENCE (terminology corrected this run - DELAYED RESPONSE ASSESSMENT, not rectal-style watch-and-wait): ACT II post-hoc 'Best time to assess complete clinical response after chemoradiotherapy...' (Glynne-Jones, Lancet Oncol 2017 - PMID 28209296, pubmed-url-match) - tumors keep regressing for months; failure is not declared before ~26 weeks (the specific conversion statistic MEMORY-GRADE - the first confirmatory pull when the channel returns) | PMID 28209296 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE p16/HPV RECEIPTS, verified: meta-analysis of CRT-treated disease (PMID 31301958, pubmed-url-match - p16+/HPV+ OS HR 0.27 [0.15-0.48] verified snippet); cohort receipts matched (21128253; 24821878 - HPV16 in 81% of tumors; 4-yr PFS 63.1% vs 15.6%, OS 84.6% vs 39.8% verified snippet). Prognostic weight, not (yet) a treatment router | PMID 31301958 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE RISING-BURDEN RECEIPTS: Deshmukh (JNCI 2020 - PMID 31742639, pubmed-url-match): mortality +3.1%/yr, incidence-based mortality +1.9%/yr (+4.9%/yr ages 60-69) - verified snippet; Clifford risk-scale meta (PMID 32621759, matched - the canonical ~85/100,000 MSM-PLWH figure MEMORY-GRADE, marked); the ~90% HPV-attributable fraction MEMORY-GRADE (marked; HPV16-in-tumor 81% verified)

ANCHOR - prevention with a randomized receipt (DOI-CITED: 10.1056/NEJMoa2201048, NEJM 2022;386:2273-82 - the primary PMID NEVER url-matched across 3 attempts, hiding behind a COMMENTARY-DECOY CLUSTER: the design paper 35017115 (matched - do not substitute), an EBM commentary, and an AAFP POEM all outrank it): 4,459 PLWH >=35 randomized - 9 vs 21 cancers, 173 vs 402 per 100,000 person-years = 57% REDUCTION (verified via secondary sources; the briefing's ~57% confirmed) - treating HSIL prevents anal cancer; stopped early for efficacy | PMID 35704479 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

Screening guidance pointer: 'Recent Guidelines on Anal Cancer Screening: A Systematic Review' (PMID 40019005, pubmed-url-match) - the verified pointer to the 2024 international (IANS) consensus (primary guideline PMID unverified; secondhand); HRA capacity is the documented implementation bottleneck | PMID 40019005 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

InterAAct (Rao, JCO 2020 - PMID 32530769, pubmed-url-match): randomized phase 2, cisplatin/5-FU vs carboplatin/paclitaxel - carbo/taxol became the SOC per the verified conclusion (the specific ORR/OS values memory-grade, held: similar response, fewer serious AEs, longer OS). THE NAME TRAP: 'InterAAct' vs 'InterAACT 2' (= POD1UM-303) - spell exactly | PMID 32530769 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE 2025 REWRITE: POD1UM-303/InterAACT-2 (Lancet 2025 - PMID 40517007, pubmed-url-match): retifanlimab + carbo/taxol vs placebo + carbo/taxol - progression/death risk reduced 37% (verified snippet; the mPFS 9.3 vs 7.4 and mOS 29.2 vs 23.0 figures secondary-source grade, marked). FDA 2025-05-15 (verified secondhand across >=6 concordant sources - the FIRST-EVER anal-specific approval): (1) 1L retifanlimab + carboplatin/paclitaxel; (2) retifanlimab MONOTHERAPY post-platinum. PATHWAY TYPE (traditional vs accelerated) UNRESOLVED after dedicated searches - authored without the qualifier until the FDA letter is pulled | PMID 40517007 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25 UPDATE 2026-09-07: registry record NCT04472429 COMPLETED (primary completion 2024-04-15 actual, study completion 2025-09-26 actual, results posted on registry 2025-05-23 - REGISTRY FIRSTHAND); a final/updated survival analysis is published (Ann Oncol 2026-08, PMID 42097353, DOI 10.1016/j.annonc.2026.04.016) - its specific OS figures NOT yet imported (pending firsthand read; the Lancet-anchored numbers above stand until then)

POST-PLATINUM IO - approved vs compendial, the line drawn: RETIFANLIMAB mono APPROVED (POD1UM-202 - PMID 35816951, pubmed-url-match: ORR 13.8%, 1 CR + 12 PR verified snippet); NIVOLUMAB compendial (NCI9673 - PMID 28223062, matched: ORR 24%, mPFS 4.1, mOS 11.5 verified snippet; THE ADJACENT-PMID HAZARD documented - 28223061 is an unrelated one-digit-off editorial; Part B nivo+/-ipi READ OUT JCO 2025, unpulled - do not cite its result); PEMBROLIZUMAB compendial (KN-028 28453692 + KN-158 35114169, both matched; ORRs ~17%/~11% memory-grade). NCCN-compendial != FDA-approved - the distinction IS the teaching | PMID 28223062 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE CLOSED GENERATION + THE STALE-LISTING TRAP: EA2182/DECREASE (NCT04166318, de-escalated CRT early-stage) CLOSED per ECOG-ACRIN's own site, results pending ~2029 - while MD Anderson and blog pages STILL read 'now enrolling' (STALE - the trap taught); EA2165 (nivolumab after CRT, high-risk II-IIIB) CLOSED per ECOG-ACRIN 2026-04 - hospital listings stale, phase II-vs-III sources conflict, NOT read out (do not cite an answer); EA2176 (NCT04444921, 1L carbo/taxol +/- nivolumab) FULLY ENROLLED/active-not-recruiting - its question partially pre-empted by the retifanlimab approval (the tension taught)

PLATO (UK platform - EX-US, never a US door; THE ACT-NAME COLLISION documented: UK 'ACT I/II' anal trials vs PLATO's 'ACT3/4/5'): ACT4 READ OUT (Lancet Oncol 2025 - publication confirmed by exact title at thelancet.com; PMID uncaptured): reduced-dose 41.4-Gy CRT - 3-yr locoregional-failure-free 87.6% (snippet grade), fewer side effects - the strongest current de-escalation EVIDENCE; ACT3 (T1N0 post-excision margin-directed) and ACT5 (dose-escalation 3-arm) designs snippet-verified, statuses unverified | PMID 40334666 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

ctHPVDNA-response-adapted CRT +/- retifanlimab (NCT07425054): the flagship new US door - listing last updated 2026-06; sponsor/sites/recruiting status UNVERIFIED (flagged) - web-verified 2026-08-20, registry re-check due. Adjacent landscape receipt: NavDx TTMV-HPV DNA Medicare coverage for ASCC surveillance (a COVERAGE decision, not an approval - said; the 117-patient multicenter series detects recurrence ~2 months before imaging, secondary grade)

Big Ten BTCRC-GI22-588 (NCT06493019): single-arm phase 2 - weekly carboplatin/paclitaxel CRT x6 then pembrolizumab maintenance, stage I-IIIA (n=23) - ENROLLING per CenterWatch/ASCO TPS 2025 - web-verified 2026-08-20, re-check due. Framed honestly: a REGIMEN-SWAP + IO question (mitomycin-free), NOT dose de-escalation - not a DECREASE successor

Rutgers E7 TCR-T (NCT05686226): phase 1/2 engineered TCR-T for HPV16+ cancers (HLA-A*02:01) - RECRUITING per CGTlive/CenterWatch (single site, NJ) - web-verified 2026-08-20, re-check due - with THE TWO-LISTING CONFLICT flagged LOUD: a second Rutgers protocol (possibly NCT05639972 - E7 TCR INDUCTION, locoregional) appeared in the same sources; which protocol(s) accept metastatic anal patients needs the registry - the doors are NOT collapsed. Phase-1 lineage (NCI Surgery Branch; Nature Medicine 2021 regressions) secondary grade

THE SHELF: NCI PDS0101 triplet (NCT04287868 - HPV-basket incl. anal; interim mOS 21 mo CPI-refractory, secondary grade) carries a LOUD STATUS CONFLICT (a reported recruitment suspension vs later expanded-data coverage - open/closed state UNVERIFIED); TG4001+avelumab READ OUT NEGATIVE (PFS missed); VERSATILE-003 is HNSCC-ONLY (never doored for anal); NOAC9 ctDNA-guided follow-up is NORDIC (ex-US); the artesunate HSIL phase 2 unverified; the retifanlimab EAP (NCT06910137) likely superseded post-approval; the 2026 NCCN patient-guideline breadth claim (many 1L IO agents) POSSIBLY A SOURCE ERROR - verify against the actual MS before authoring (loud flag)

POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.
